title: Add lens-based parallel review to vidhi
description: Split vidhi's code review into parallel subagent lenses run within a single session. Each lens focuses on a specific concern: security/unsafe patterns, test coverage gaps, API surface consistency with sibling crates, performance hotpaths/allocations, and docs/comment drift vs behavior. Agents run concurrently, findings are deduplicated and ranked by severity, output as a markdown checklist. This is an improvement to the existing vidhi skill, not a new system — no karma/sangha infrastructure needed.
